extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is a dataset for semantic-controlled video generation containing over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by collecting 2,000 high-quality reference images from the internet and then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs to generate paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2,000 high-quality reference images sourced from the internet, covering categories such as men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was created automatically by matching curated reference images to compatible Image-to-Video visual-effects templates to generate paired videos.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial Image-to-Video models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from the source generative models used to create it.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is synthetic, derived from other generative models (commercial models and community LoRAs), and its semantic conditions are relatively limited compared to real-world data.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The technology and data carry risks of misuse, including the creation of deepfakes, identity impersonation, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and violent or sexualized media.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images of people, specifically categorized by age and gender (men, women, children).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended strictly for research, education, and creative prototyping. It is explicitly not recommended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Evenly sampling and balancing semantic conditions to create the test subset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Resizing videos to a standard resolution and sampling a fixed number of frames at a specific frame rate.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: VAP may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: the semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deep-fake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.

rai:personalSensitiveInformation.evidence: we collect 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Scope and intended use (research-only). VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping... It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: For evaluation, we evenly sampled 24 semantic conditions from 4 categories (concept, style, motion, camera) in the test subset, with 2 samples each.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Following pre-trained DiTs, we resize videos to 480 × 720 (832) and sample 49 frames at 16 fps.
